mainServices.title: Spa Complexes
mainServices.desc: Zone layout affects average spend and dwell time — this is established before construction begins, not adjusted after opening. When the space is built around a single thermal-journey logic, guests don't think about where to go next — they simply stay.

mainServices.title: Aromatic Rooms
mainServices.desc: A controlled environment with precise humidity, temperature and essential-oil concentration management. Scent activates emotional memory more reliably than any visual solution — guests remember not how the room looked, but how they felt inside it.

mainServices.title: Bathhouses & Saunas
mainServices.desc: We build in compliance with traditional steam-generation techniques and current safety standards — a well-built sauna or bath becomes the anchor zone guests plan their next visit around. The ritual of heat and steam releases accumulated physical and mental tension: guests leave feeling their body is theirs again.

mainServices.title: Hammams & Roman Steam Rooms
mainServices.desc: A hammam demands precise work with marble, underfloor heating and even steam distribution — the Roman steam room adds high humidity and gentle heat that is easier to bear than dry. Both formats serve the same goal: deep relaxation through heat that envelops rather than presses.

mainServices.title: Pools & Plunge Baths
mainServices.desc: Filtration, water chemistry, finishing and engineering are set out in a single technical brief — key parameters: disinfection type, recirculation volume, heat loss through walls and surface. The right temperature, clarity and acoustic quality of the water create a weightlessness that is hard to reproduce anywhere else in a city.

mainServices.title: Japanese Furo & Ofuro Baths
mainServices.desc: Furo is an outdoor wooden tub with direct heating; ofuro is a compact indoor bath for individual immersion. Both require precise timber selection, joint sealing and a temperature-maintenance system that avoids overheating — we have delivered these on operational sites; typical service issues are resolved at the design stage.

mainServices.title: Snow Rooms
mainServices.desc: Accurate calculation of refrigeration equipment, insulation and snow-distribution systems determines the consistency of the experience and operating costs for years ahead — correctly executed, this is the zone with the highest repeat-visit rate per single session. The sharp shift from heat to cold produces an intense endorphin rush: a state between shock and euphoria that guests remember long afterwards.

mainServices.title: Outdoor Jacuzzis
mainServices.desc: Materials and engineering systems are selected for the specific regional climate — from the humid south to the frozen north — ensuring year-round operation without seasonal downtime. Hot water under open sky creates a sensation unattainable indoors, especially in the evening: an experience guests seek out deliberately.

mainServices.title: Heated Infinity Pool
mainServices.desc: Hydraulic design of the overflow channel and sound insulation determine both operating costs and the preservation of the visual effect for the entire service life — this is one of the elements with the greatest impact on a complex's media presence. The dissolved horizon line creates a rare sense of boundless space — this is where guests most often stop and simply look.

mainServices.title: Moroccan-Style Hammam
mainServices.desc: The authentic format requires hand-applied zellige tiling, plaster stucco and a proper steam system — without these the visual and thermal effect is lost. The interior detail transports guests into a different cultural context — an immersion in a tradition virtually impossible to find outside Morocco.

mainServices.title: Sports Pool
mainServices.desc: We design for real load: lane length, depth, acoustics and filtration are calculated for intensive daily use — a full sports pool broadens the complex's audience and justifies a higher membership price. For performance-oriented guests, a pool is not an option but a condition of choice.

mainServices.title: Cold Plunge Bath
mainServices.desc: Volume, temperature and position relative to hot zones affect how guests move through the entire thermal journey and how long they stay — this element has one of the highest influences on repeat-visit frequency. The moment of plunging into cold water after heat is the sharpest episode of the whole visit: it delivers a sense of total bodily presence that guests think about for days after.

mainServices.title: Hay Room
mainServices.desc: Design priorities are airtightness, humidity control and allergen-free plant material selection — a rare format with high demand among above-average wellness audiences. The warm scent of hay and herbs activates something very deep — akin to a childhood memory of safety and peace that wellness audiences seek but rarely know how to name.

mgmtServices.title: Pre-Project Research
mgmtServices.desc: Market, demand and competitor analysis before design begins reduces costly late-stage changes and directly affects return on investment.

mgmtServices.title: Market Analysis
mgmtServices.desc: We assess real demand in the location, audience price expectations and segment saturation — the data forms the foundation of the concept and financial model.

mgmtServices.title: Service Demand Analysis
mgmtServices.desc: We identify which formats are in demand with a specific audience in a specific city — zone composition directly affects average revenue per guest.

mgmtServices.title: Competitor Analysis
mgmtServices.desc: We examine which audience needs in the location remain unmet — from these, the facility's positioning is formed.

mgmtServices.title: Unique Concept Development
mgmtServices.desc: The concept is the brand foundation: it determines zone composition, pricing and how the facility exists in the guest's mind before they visit.

mgmtServices.title: Comprehensive Management
mgmtServices.desc: We take on operational processes: service standards, financial reporting, quality control. The owner gets a managed business and the freedom to focus on development.

mgmtServices.title: Staff Selection & Training
mgmtServices.desc: Staff shapes the impression of a facility no less than the interior — we select to the facility's standards and train before opening.

mgmtServices.title: Construction Control Scheme
mgmtServices.desc: We monitor compliance with the design, delivery timelines and work quality at every stage. What was conceived on paper remains the same in the final result.

4elements.title: 4 Elements
4elements.quote: An organic fusion of traditional timber construction and a contemporary wellness concept.
4elements.description: A unique combination of traditional and modern timber-building techniques creating high-quality, eco-friendly structures that blend naturally into the surrounding landscape.
4elements.positioning: The project was created for an audience that values authenticity and ecological responsibility.
4elements.positioningSub: The complex is positioned as a place where natural materials and traditional techniques create an atmosphere of comfort and well-being for relaxation and rejuvenation.
4elements.p1: The project represents a unique fusion of traditional and modern timber-building technologies. The use of cedar logs and the Diamond notch technique produced buildings with exceptional thermal performance.
4elements.p2: All buildings blend organically into the natural landscape. The natural material palette — cedar, stone, thermo-wood — creates a unified visual language that complements rather than competes with nature.
4elements.p3: The complex has become a benchmark project in eco-friendly timber wellness construction.
4elements.p3Sub: The Diamond notch technique combined with STEICO Zell insulation delivers below-average operating costs for the class.
4elements.materials: Cedar logs as the primary structural material — high strength and phytoncide emission. STEICO Zell wood-fibre insulation — reliable thermal protection without chemical additives.
4elements.buildingTech: Diamond notch technique — a traditional corner-notching method that ensures maximum joint density without additional sealants.
4elements.energy: The project is designed to minimise heat loss. STEICO Zell is a natural wood-based material with high vapour permeability that maintains an optimal microclimate.
4elements.ecology: Only natural, health-safe materials. Cedar logs emit phytoncides that are beneficial to health. STEICO Zell provides insulation without harmful chemicals.

gaisin.title: Gaisin Wellness
gaisin.quote: A private wellness complex with a complete thermal journey in the heart of Podillia.
gaisin.description: A private health complex in Haisyn — compact yet functionally complete: Finnish sauna, steam room, cold plunge bath and a relaxation zone.
gaisin.positioning: The facility was created as a high-class private wellness space organically integrated into the landscape.
gaisin.positioningSub: Positioning strategy — premium private spa accessible without travelling abroad.
gaisin.p1: The client's brief was to create a complete thermal journey within a compact footprint: Finnish sauna with antechamber, hammam, plunge bath and rest zone all working as one system without cross-flow.
gaisin.p2: The layout is built on the 'thermal circuit' principle — guests move from heat to cooling and back without crossing paths. A separate exit onto an open terrace with garden views.
gaisin.p3: The project is currently under construction with completion planned for 2024. The complex is expected to be one of the first of its class in the region.
gaisin.materials: Siberian cedar, natural stone, thermo-wood — all materials chosen for durability and aesthetics.
gaisin.buildingTech: Frame-panel technology with a timber load-bearing structure. Integrated engineering systems to European standards.
gaisin.energy: Designed with passive energy saving in mind: insulated envelope, heat recovery, automated climate control.
gaisin.ecology: Natural materials with no toxic additives. UV-filtration-based water treatment system.

vosparenie.title: Vospareniye · Vdoh
vosparenie.quote: The sauna became a regional landmark — its architecture and authenticity draw guests from afar.
vosparenie.description: The Vospareniye bathing complex is located on the grounds of the Vdoh hotel. It comprises timber sauna buildings constructed using a unique log-building technique.
vosparenie.positioning: The sauna became a tourist attraction of the region, drawing visitors who want to witness the unique log construction technique and enjoy an authentic, relaxing stay.
vosparenie.p1: This project combines traditional log construction with additional structures required by the concept. A conical building was created to house a communal sauna and two separate rest rooms.
vosparenie.p2: The experiment with split logs proved highly successful — hand-hewn sections and chinking create a character in every building that cannot be replicated mechanically.
vosparenie.p3: The complex has become a draw for hotel guests and local residents alike. The unique architectural technique became a standalone story in its own right.
vosparenie.materials: Cedar logs — the primary structural material with high heat capacity and a natural antibacterial effect.
vosparenie.buildingTech: Combined technique: log construction + Post and Beam. Conical building with a communal sauna and two separate rest rooms.
vosparenie.energy: The use of natural timber and the specialist log-building method preserve heat and minimise energy consumption.
vosparenie.ecology: Only natural, clean materials. Cedar logs emit phytoncides that are beneficial to health.

emily-resort.title: Emily Resort
emily-resort.quote: The thermal journey became the resort's primary competitive advantage — guests return for it.
emily-resort.description: Emily Resort is an innovative multi-function wellness complex on the shore of a natural lake. It features 12 unique saunas and steam rooms, each offering specialised therapeutic treatments.
emily-resort.positioning: Emily Resort is a unique wellness complex combining traditional bathing practices with modern technology.
emily-resort.p1: The project started from zero: not a single wellness zone in the existing building. Together with architects we developed a layout that guides guests along a single thermal journey — from warm-up to relaxation.
emily-resort.p2: The hammam was built using traditional Ottoman steam generation: marble floor heating, precise humidity control, authentic hand-laid mosaic. Alongside it — four saunas with different temperature profiles and plunge baths on a thermal circuit.
emily-resort.p3: The hotel gained a wellness offering that now drives up to 30% of repeat bookings.
emily-resort.energy: Automated heating and ventilation systems regulate temperature and humidity according to conditions.
emily-resort.ecology: Natural materials (Siberian cedar, Himalayan salt, natural stone and clay) with no harmful chemicals.
emily-resort.buildingTech: Innovative systems — automated steam delivery, heated walls and floors, advanced water treatment.

sadu.title: Sadu SPA
sadu.quote: The ethnic character and natural materials turned a technical constraint into a distinctive design code.
sadu.description: Sadu SPA is a spa zone in the hotel basement executed in authentic Kazakh ethnic style. The main challenge was to create a comfortable, authentic space despite limited area and low ceilings.
sadu.positioning: Sadu is a unique spa space combining Kazakh cultural traditions with modern technology.
sadu.p1: Working in the hotel basement presented several non-standard challenges: low ceilings, dense engineering utilities and limited area. The Kazakh ethnic style became not just décor but a planning principle.
sadu.p2: The two clay steam rooms are the project's defining feature. Clay acts as a natural heat accumulator: walls heat slowly and release warmth over a long time, creating soft, enveloping steam without sharp temperature swings.
sadu.p3: The Sadu spa zone has become a distinctive attraction of the hotel, naturally integrated into its Kazakh character.
sadu.materials: Clay, timber, natural stone. Natural materials in keeping with the Kazakh style are used throughout.
sadu.buildingTech: The treatment zone is equipped with Sangens stoves providing even heat distribution throughout the steam rooms.
sadu.energy: Clay steam rooms deliver high energy efficiency thanks to the natural thermal properties of clay.
sadu.ecology: The use of natural materials — clay, timber and stone — makes the project environmentally clean.
